rules.statement: On a question of pure law, where the Code is silent, the proper course is to refer to standard text books on the subject rather than resorting to expert opinions.
rules.supporting_quote: "On a question of pure law (as distinguished from questions of usage or practice), where our Code of Muhammadan law is silent, the proper course is to refer to the standard text books on the subject, and not to resort to the opinions of experts."
